aiTitle: Cache pip in CI: 6 min to 1 min 40

message.content: CI takes 6 minutes per push and most of it looks like installing dependencies. Speed it up.

content.text: Reading the step timings from the last run.

input.description: Show step durations of the last CI run

content.content:
Install dependencies   4m 12s
Start postgres service  0m 21s
Test                   1m 03s

content.text: 70% of the run is `pip install` compiling the same wheels every time. Caching pip, keyed on the hash of `requirements.txt`, turns it into a restore. The Postgres service container stays: tests hit a real database on purpose, since mocking it hid a migration bug last month.

input.command: gh workflow run ci.yml && gh run watch

content.content:
✓ Install dependencies   0m 14s (cache hit)
✓ Start postgres service  0m 20s
✓ Test                   1m 02s
Total 1m 41s

content.text: CI went from **6 min to 1 min 41 s** on a cache hit. A cache miss (when requirements change) costs the old 4 minutes once, then it's cached again.
